players.product: power cable (LV / MV / HV) and busduct, including via US subsidiary LS Cable & System U.S.A. (LSCUS)

quarterly_data.quarter: LS Cable & System press release: release ea-b0-80-ec-98-a8-ec-a0-84-ec-84-a0-ec-9 (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gaon Cable (release on LS Cable & System's newsroom about its record Q3 2026 preliminary results): nine-month 2026 revenue of KRW 2.6194 trillion and operating profit of KRW 116.0 billion already exceed full-year 2025 revenue of KRW 2.5457 trillion and operating profit of KRW 79.2 billion. The release attributes the results to rising cable and busduct demand from US AI data center (AIDC), renewable-energy and power-grid investment, and says Gaon Cable's distribution-cable exports keep growing on US supply shortages and grid investment. A Gaon Cable official: the structural growth of the US power-infrastructure market continues, centred on AIDC and grid investment, and the company will keep its record results and profitability improvement going on export growth and LSCUS's growth.
quarterly_data.figure: 9M 2026 revenue KRW 2.6194 trillion vs full-year 2025 KRW 2.5457 trillion

quarterly_data.quarter: LS Cable & System press release: release ea-b0-80-ec-98-a8-ec-a0-84-ec-84-a0-ec-9 (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: US production subsidiary LSCUS supplies busduct to the AIDCs of US big tech in cooperation with LS Cable & System and has become a global top-5 busduct supplier (company claim); in its LSCUS paragraph the release says that, with supply of cable for AIDCs and solar farms also expanding, this year's annual revenue (in context LSCUS's, not Gaon Cable's consolidated revenue) is expected to grow to about twice last year's level.
quarterly_data.figure: annual revenue expected at about twice last year's level
